_comment: Searches that decide a verdict inside a fixed-size slice, as they stand on the tree declaration_searched_only_inside_a_truncated_window.py shipped with. MAY ONLY SHRINK; a row matching nothing is rc 1. Each closes by keeping the window for display and re-running the search over the full text, reporting a marker found outside the window as its own outcome. Hand-authored from --json; there is no --write-baseline.

known.reason: A 4096-byte head window over a sign-off report, searched for a format marker. Same shape, same remedy: keep the window for display and re-search the full text on a miss.

THE INSTANCE THE CAPTURE MEASURED. `declared_intent` searches the ENFORCEMENT declaration inside `text[:4000]`, so a twelve-line intent block at byte 8249 was reported as 'declares no intent at all' — prose above the marker silently un-declares the gate. Control pair through this exact predicate: a byte-identical declaration returns 'blocking' at byte 26 and None at byte 5121. On this tree every declaration is inside the window, so the repair adds no finding today; it prevents the next one.
A 200-byte head of the prompt searched for a structural cue. The window is small enough that a cue stated in a second sentence is invisible, and the miss is read as the cue being absent.

Head windows of 1200 and 2000 bytes over ingested document text, searched for markers whose miss steers extraction. A document whose front matter grows past the bound changes verdict with no edit to the sentence that matters.
